# Every chart

<!-- Generated by charts/scripts/components.mjs from WireCharts' docs; edit the script, not this file. -->

All of [WireCharts](https://wirecharts.io)' charts, as `@elyra/charts`
components ([RFC 0059](proposals/0059-all-of-wirecharts.md)), each with
WireCharts' props and the example from its docs. Every one also takes what
[every chart takes](charts.md#the-charts): `live`, `height`, `label`,
`format`, `locale`, `renderer`, `onselect`, `labels` and `class`. Where a
chart's own `labels` names its points, a list is those names and an object
its words.

The 3D charts come from `@elyra/charts/gl` and need `echarts-gl`
installed beside it.

## Basics

### LineChart

Plot one or more series over a category axis. Supports smooth (spline) and stepped lines. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineChart
  series={[{name: "Revenue", data: [120, 180, 150, 260, 300]}, {name: "Cost", data: [80, 110, 95, 140, 160]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"]}
  smooth
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]) or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `false` | Render a smooth spline instead of straight segments. |
| `step` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Render a stepped line (start, middle or end). |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack series on top of each other. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### AreaChart

A filled line chart, ideal for showing volume over time. Stack series for cumulative totals. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaChart
  series={[{name: "Sessions", data: [30, 40, 35, 50, 49, 60]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]}
  smooth
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `false` | Render smooth curves. |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack the areas. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### ColumnChart

Vertical bars for comparing values across categories. Stack to compare composition. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { ColumnChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ColumnChart
  series={[{name: "Sales", data: [44, 55, 41, 67, 22]}]}
  categories={["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack the columns. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### BarChart

Horizontal bars — perfect for ranked lists and long category labels. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { BarChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<BarChart
  series={[{name: "Votes", data: [120, 90, 70, 50]}]}
  categories={["Vue", "React", "Svelte", "Angular"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the category axis. |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack the bars. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### PieChart

Show parts of a whole. Pass flat values with labels, or pre-shaped data objects. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { PieChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<PieChart
  series={[44, 55, 13, 33]}
  labels={["Chrome", "Safari", "Edge", "Firefox"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Flat values, or [name, value] objects. |
| `labels` | `array` | `[]` | Slice labels (when series is a flat list). |
| `rose` | `bool` | `false` | Render as a Nightingale rose chart. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the legend. |

### ScatterChart

Plot raw [x, y] points to reveal correlations and clusters. (The 0.58 chart: see [the charts](charts.md#the-charts).)

```svelte
<script>
  import { ScatterChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ScatterChart
  series={[{name: "Group A", data: [[10, 20], [15, 25], [22, 18]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series of [x, y] point arrays. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

## Line charts

### SplineChart

A smooth line where each series is marked with a distinct point symbol — circle, square, triangle, diamond and more.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SplineChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SplineChart
  series={[{name: "Tokyo", data: [7, 7, 13, 17, 22, 25]}, {name: "London", data: [4, 5, 8, 12, 16, 19]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]) or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `symbolSize` | `int` | `8` | Marker size in pixels. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### SplineInvertedChart

A smooth line with the category axis running vertically — ideal for profiles such as temperature by altitude.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SplineInvertedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SplineInvertedChart
  series={[{name: "Temperature", data: [15, 8, -5, -40, -55]}]}
  categories={["0 km", "5 km", "10 km", "20 km", "30 km"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the vertical category axis. |
| `symbolSize` | `int` | `6` | Marker size in pixels. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### LineLabelsChart

Labels each series at the end of its line instead of using a legend.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineLabelsChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineLabelsChart
  series={[{name: "Solar", data: [42, 50, 62, 80]}, {name: "Wind", data: [30, 38, 41, 55]}]}
  categories={["2019", "2020", "2021", "2022"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `false` | Render smooth lines. |

### LineLogChart

A line chart with a logarithmic y-axis for values spanning several orders of magnitude.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineLogChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineLogChart
  series={[{name: "Users", data: [1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000]}]}
  categories={["2018", "2019", "2020", "2021", "2022"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `logBase` | `int` | `10` | Logarithm base. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### LineRaceChart

An animated line race that reveals each series progressively, with a replay control.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineRaceChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineRaceChart
  series={[{name: "USA", data: [10, 20, 35, 50, 61]}, {name: "China", data: [5, 18, 40, 62, 78]}]}
  categories={["2019", "2020", "2021", "2022", "2023"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `interval` | `int` | `400` | Milliseconds between revealed points. |

### LineAnimatedChart

A line chart with a custom entrance animation — configurable easing and a staggered per-point delay.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineAnimatedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineAnimatedChart
  series={[{name: "Visits", data: [120, 200, 150, 280, 300]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}
  easing="elasticOut"
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `easing` | `string` | `cubicOut` | Animation easing (e.g. elasticOut). |
| `duration` | `int` | `1200` | Animation duration in ms. |

### LineForecastChart

Draws actual values solid and forecast values as a dashed line over a shaded region.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineForecastChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineForecastChart
  categories={["2020", "2021", "2022", "2023", "2024"]}
  actual={[100, 120, 140]}
  forecast={[165, 190]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `actual` | `array` | `[]` | The real values. |
| `forecast` | `array` | `[]` | The predicted values continuing after actual. |
| `forecastName` | `string` | `Forecast` | Label for the forecast series. |

### LineAnnotatedChart

Labelled annotation pins on chosen points, plus an optional average reference line.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineAnnotatedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineAnnotatedChart
  series={[{name: "Sales", data: [120, 300, 180, 90, 260]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"]}
  annotations={[{x: "Feb", y: 300, text: "Peak"}]}
  average
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `annotations` | `array` | `[]` | Pins as [x, y, text]. |
| `average` | `bool` | `false` | Draw an average reference line. |

### LineBoostChart

Tuned for very large datasets with LTTB downsampling and zoom/pan controls.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineBoostChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<!-- points: a long list of numbers -->
<LineBoostChart
  series={[{name: "Signal", data: points}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series ([name, data]); data can be huge. |
| `sampling` | `string` | `lttb` | Downsampling strategy. |
| `zoom` | `bool` | `true` | Show zoom/pan controls. |

### LineTimeChart

A line over a datetime axis. Data points are [date, value] pairs, with zoom/pan.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LineTimeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LineTimeChart
  series={[{name: "USD/EUR", data: [["2024-01-01", 0.91], ["2024-02-01", 0.93], ["2024-03-01", 0.92]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with [date, value] data pairs. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `false` | Render smooth lines. |
| `zoom` | `bool` | `true` | Show zoom/pan controls. |

### SplineTimeChart

A smooth spline over an irregular datetime axis with visible measurement points.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SplineTimeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SplineTimeChart
  series={[{name: "Snow depth", data: [["2024-01-03", 0.45], ["2024-01-19", 0.88], ["2024-02-11", 1.2]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with [date, value] data pairs. |
| `symbolSize` | `int` | `6` | Marker size in pixels. |
| `zoom` | `bool` | `true` | Show zoom/pan controls. |

### SplineBandsChart

A spline with coloured horizontal plot bands marking value zones.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SplineBandsChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SplineBandsChart
  series={[{name: "Wind", data: [4, 8, 12, 6, 10]}]}
  categories={["00", "06", "12", "18", "24"]}
  bands={[{from: 0, to: 5, color: "rgba(68, 170, 213, 0.1)", label: "Light"}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `bands` | `array` | `[]` | Zones as [from, to, color, label]. |

## Area charts

### AreaGradientChart

A smooth area chart where each series fades from its colour to transparent. Optionally stacked.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaGradientChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaGradientChart
  series={[{name: "Revenue", data: [120, 180, 150, 260]}]}
  categories={["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack the areas. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `true` | Render smooth curves. |

### AreaStackedChart

Filled series stacked on top of one another to show cumulative totals and composition.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaStackedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaStackedChart
  series={[{name: "Asia", data: [1700, 2300, 3600]}, {name: "Africa", data: [230, 360, 640]}]}
  categories={["1950", "1970", "1990"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `false` | Render smooth curves. |

### AreaPercentChart

A 100% stacked area chart showing each series as a percentage of the total.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaPercentChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaPercentChart
  series={[{name: "Desktop", data: [60, 55, 48]}, {name: "Mobile", data: [40, 45, 52]}]}
  categories={["2021", "2022", "2023"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |

### AreasplineChart

A smooth area chart with semi-transparent overlapping fills.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreasplineChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreasplineChart
  series={[{name: "John", data: [3, 4, 3, 5, 4, 10, 12]}, {name: "Jane", data: [1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `stack` | `bool\|string` | `false` | Stack the areas. |

### AreaInvertedChart

A filled area chart with the category axis running vertically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaInvertedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaInvertedChart
  series={[{name: "Depth", data: [5, 12, 20, 9]}]}
  categories={["0 m", "10 m", "20 m", "30 m"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the vertical category axis. |
| `smooth` | `bool` | `true` | Render smooth curves. |

### AreaNegativeChart

An area chart whose line and fill are coloured differently above and below zero.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaNegativeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaNegativeChart
  series={[{name: "Net", data: [5, -3, 8, -6, 2]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `positiveColor` | `string` | `#22c55e` | Colour above zero. |
| `negativeColor` | `string` | `#ef4444` | Colour below zero. |

### AreaMissingChart

Handles null values — leaving a gap, or bridging it with connectNulls.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaMissingChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaMissingChart
  series={[{name: "Readings", data: [3, null, 5, 8, null, 6]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects; use null for gaps. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `connectNulls` | `bool` | `false` | Bridge gaps instead of breaking the line. |

### AreaRangeChart

A filled band between a low and high value per category (e.g. min/max ranges).

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaRangeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaRangeChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}
  low={[10, 12, 9, 14, 11]}
  high={[20, 25, 18, 27, 22]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `low` | `array` | `[]` | The lower bound per category. |
| `high` | `array` | `[]` | The upper bound per category. |

### AreaRangeLineChart

A low/high band with a line (e.g. the average) drawn on top.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaRangeLineChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaRangeLineChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}
  low={[10, 12, 9, 14, 11]}
  high={[20, 25, 18, 27, 22]}
  line={[15, 18, 13, 20, 16]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `low` | `array` | `[]` | Lower bound per category. |
| `high` | `array` | `[]` | Upper bound per category. |
| `line` | `array` | `[]` | The overlaid line values. |

### AreaFanChart

A central line surrounded by nested confidence bands — ideal for forecasts with uncertainty.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AreaFanChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AreaFanChart
  categories={["Now", "+1", "+2", "+3"]}
  line={[10, 11, 12, 13]}
  bands={[{low: [8, 6, 4, 2], high: [12, 16, 20, 24]}, {low: [9, 8, 7, 6], high: [11, 14, 17, 20]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `line` | `array` | `[]` | The central (median) values. |
| `bands` | `array` | `[]` | Nested bands as [low, high]. |

### AreaRaceChart

An animated area race that reveals each filled series progressively, with a replay control.

```svelte

/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `interval` | `int` | `400` | Milliseconds between revealed points. |

| Prop | Type | Default | |

## Column & bar

### ColumnStackedChart

Vertical bars stacked to show cumulative totals and composition.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ColumnStackedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ColumnStackedChart
  series={[{name: "Product A", data: [44, 55, 41, 67]}, {name: "Product B", data: [13, 23, 20, 8]}]}
  categories={["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |

### BarStackedChart

```svelte
<script>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects ([name, data]). |

```svelte
<ColumnNegativeChart
  series={[{name: "Net", data: [5, -3, 8, -6, 2]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `positiveColor` | `string` | `#22c55e` | Colour for positive bars. |
| `negativeColor` | `string` | `#ef4444` | Colour for negative bars. |

### ColumnRotatedChart

A column chart with rotated category labels — handy for many or long labels.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ColumnRotatedChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ColumnRotatedChart
  series={[{name: "Visitors", data: [820, 932, 901, 934, 1290, 1330]}]}
  categories={["Amsterdam", "Barcelona", "Copenhagen", "Dublin", "Edinburgh", "Florence"]}
  rotate={45}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `rotate` | `int` | `45` | Label rotation in degrees. |

### ColumnRangeChart

Floating vertical bars from a low to a high value per category.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ColumnRangeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ColumnRangeChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}
  low={[10, 12, 9, 14, 11]}
  high={[20, 25, 18, 27, 22]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `low` | `array` | `[]` | Lower bound per category. |
| `high` | `array` | `[]` | Upper bound per category. |

### BarRangeChart

Floating horizontal bars from a low to a high value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { BarRangeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<BarRangeChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed"]}
  low={[10, 12, 9]}
  high={[20, 25, 18]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the category axis. |
| `low` | `array` | `[]` | Lower bound per category. |
| `high` | `array` | `[]` | Upper bound per category. |

### HistogramChart

Bins a flat list of numeric values into frequency columns.

```svelte
<script>
  import { HistogramChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<HistogramChart
  data={[1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 8, 13, 21]}
  bins={6}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `array` | `[]` | A flat list of numeric values. |
| `bins` | `int` | `10` | Number of bins. |

### LollipopChart

A thin stick topped with a circular marker for each value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { LollipopChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<LollipopChart
  series={[{name: "Score", data: [42, 67, 31, 88, 54]}]}
  categories={["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | A single series ([name, data]). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |

### ParetoChart

Columns sorted descending with a cumulative percentage line on a second axis.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ParetoChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ParetoChart
  categories={["Late", "Damaged", "Wrong item", "Other"]}
  data={[120, 80, 40, 20]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Category labels. |
| `data` | `array` | `[]` | The value per category. |

## Combinations

### ComboLineColumnChart

Mixed line and column series sharing one axis. Each series sets a friendly type.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboLineColumnChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ComboLineColumnChart
  series={[{name: "Revenue", type: "bar", data: [120, 132, 101, 134]}, {name: "Trend", type: "line", data: [115, 125, 110, 130]}]}
  categories={["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with a 'type' of bar, line or area. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |

### ComboDualAxisChart

Series split across a left and right y-axis — e.g. rainfall and temperature.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboDualAxisChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ComboDualAxisChart
  series={[{name: "Rainfall", type: "bar", axis: 0, data: [20, 35, 18, 42]}, {name: "Temp", type: "line", axis: 1, data: [12, 15, 9, 18]}]}
  categories={["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"]}
  axisNames={["mm", "°C"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with 'type' and 'axis' (0 or 1). |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `axisNames` | `array` | `['', '']` | Names for the left and right axes. |

### ComboMultiAxisChart

Series spread across three or more y-axes for very different scales.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboMultiAxisChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ComboMultiAxisChart
  series={[{name: "Units", type: "bar", axis: 0, data: [2, 4, 6, 5]}, {name: "Rate", type: "line", axis: 1, data: [20, 40, 60, 55]}, {name: "Volume", type: "line", axis: 2, data: [200, 100, 300, 250]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu"]}
  axes={["Units", "Rate", "Volume"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with 'type' and 'axis' index. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `axes` | `array` | `[]` | Names for each y-axis. |

## Scatter & bubble

### ScatterRegressionChart

A scatter plot with a least-squares linear trend line.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ScatterRegressionChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ScatterRegressionChart
  series={[{name: "Obs", data: [[1, 2], [2, 4], [3, 5], [4, 8], [5, 9]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | A single series of [x, y] points. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the legend. |

### ScatterSymbolsChart

A multi-series scatter where each series uses a distinct point symbol.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ScatterSymbolsChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ScatterSymbolsChart
  series={[{name: "A", data: [[10, 20], [15, 25], [22, 18]]}, {name: "B", data: [[12, 30], [18, 22], [26, 28]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series of [x, y] points. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the legend. |

### PackedBubbleChart

Force-packed bubbles sized by value and grouped by category.

```svelte
<script>
  import { PackedBubbleChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<PackedBubbleChart
  nodes={[{name: "PHP", value: 80, category: "Backend"}, {name: "Vue", value: 50, category: "Frontend"}, {name: "Redis", value: 30, category: "Backend"}]}
  categories={["Backend", "Frontend"]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `array` | `[]` | Bubbles as [name, value, category]. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Category names for grouping/colour. |

### DonutChart

```svelte
<script>

<DonutChart
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |

### FunnelChart

Visualize a pipeline: each stage as a shrinking segment.

```svelte
<script>
  import { FunnelChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<FunnelChart
  series={[100, 80, 60, 30]}
  labels={["Visits", "Signups", "Trials", "Paid"]}
/>
```

## Gauges

### GaugeChart

Show a value against a range with a classic needle or a progress ring.

```svelte
<script>
  import { GaugeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<GaugeChart
  value={72}
  name="CPU"
  progress
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `int\|float` | `0` | The value to display. |
| `min` | `int\|float` | `0` | Lower bound of the range. |
| `max` | `int\|float` | `100` | Upper bound of the range. |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Label shown beneath the value. |
| `progress` | `bool` | `false` | Use a progress ring instead of a needle. |

### ClockChart

An animated analog clock built from gauges. The hour, minute and second hands advance live every second.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClockChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<ClockChart />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `string` | `null` | Color of the second hand (defaults to the accent). |
| `options` | `array` | `[]` | Raw WireCharts option overrides, deep-merged. |

## Distribution

### BubbleChart

A scatter chart where a third value drives each point's size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { BubbleChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<BubbleChart
  series={[{name: "Plans", data: [[10, 20, 30], [15, 25, 80]]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series of [x, y, size] arrays. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the series legend. |

### HeatmapChart

A grid of cells colored by value — ideal for activity and density data.

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeatmapChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<HeatmapChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed"]}
  rows={["AM", "PM"]}
  series={[[0, 0, 5], [1, 0, 7], [2, 0, 3], [0, 1, 9], [1, 1, 2], [2, 1, 8]]}
  max={10}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | x-axis labels. |
| `rows` | `array` | `[]` | y-axis labels. |
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | [x-index, y-index, value] cells. |
| `max` | `int` | `10` | Value mapped to the most intense color. |

### CandlestickChart

OHLC financial data as candlesticks over a time axis.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CandlestickChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<CandlestickChart
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed"]}
  series={[[20, 34, 10, 38], [40, 35, 30, 50], [31, 38, 33, 44]]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | x-axis labels. |
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | [open, close, low, high] arrays. |

### BoxplotChart

Summarize distributions with min, quartiles and max.

```svelte
<script>
  import { BoxplotChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<BoxplotChart
  categories={["A", "B"]}
  series={[[20, 34, 48, 60, 75], [25, 40, 52, 66, 80]]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | x-axis labels. |
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | [min, Q1, median, Q3, max] arrays. |

### RadarChart

Compare multiple variables on a circular axis.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadarChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<RadarChart
  indicators={[{name: "Speed", max: 100}, {name: "Power", max: 100}]}
  series={[{name: "Engine", data: [80, 65]}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indicators` | `array` | `[]` | Axis definitions ([name, max]). |
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series with a value per indicator. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `true` | Show the legend. |

## Trees & network

### TreeChart

Render hierarchical data as an expandable node tree.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TreeChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<TreeChart
  data={{name: "root", children: [{name: "A", children: [{name: "A1"}, {name: "A2"}]}, {name: "B"}]}}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `array` | `[]` | A nested [name, children] hierarchy. |

### TreemapChart

Nested rectangles sized by value — dense and space-efficient.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TreemapChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<TreemapChart
  data={[{name: "Frontend", value: 40}, {name: "Backend", value: 35}, {name: "Infra", value: 25}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `array` | `[]` | [name, value] (optionally with children). |

### SunburstChart

A radial treemap for multi-level hierarchies.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SunburstChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SunburstChart
  data={[{name: "A", children: [{name: "A1", value: 5}]}, {name: "B", value: 8}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `array` | `[]` | A nested [name, value, children] hierarchy. |

### SankeyChart

Flow diagrams where link width encodes magnitude.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SankeyChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<SankeyChart
  nodes={[{name: "A"}, {name: "B"}, {name: "C"}]}
  links={[{source: "A", target: "B", value: 5}, {source: "B", target: "C", value: 3}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `array` | `[]` | Node objects ([name]). |
| `links` | `array` | `[]` | [source, target, value] links. |

### GraphChart

Force-directed nodes and edges for relationship data.

```svelte
<script>
  import { GraphChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<GraphChart
  nodes={[{name: "A"}, {name: "B"}, {name: "C"}]}
  links={[{source: "A", target: "B"}, {source: "A", target: "C"}]}
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `array` | `[]` | Node objects ([name, value, category]). |
| `links` | `array` | `[]` | [source, target] edges. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Node categories for coloring. |
| `layout` | `string` | `force` | force, circular or none. |
| `legend` | `bool` | `false` | Show the category legend. |

| `rotate` | `bool` | `false` | Auto-rotate the scene. |

## Accessibility

### AudioChart

A line chart that can be played as sound. Pitch maps to value, time to the x-axis — with a screen-reader summary.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AudioChart } from "@elyra/charts";
</script>

<AudioChart
  series={[{name: "Temp", data: [10, 14, 9, 18, 22]}]}
  categories={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]}
  duration={4000}
  instrument="triangle"
/>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` | `[]` | Series objects or a flat list of numbers. |
| `categories` | `array` | `[]` | Labels for the x-axis. |
| `track` | `int` | `0` | Which series to sonify. |
| `duration` | `int` | `5000` | Playback length in milliseconds. |
| `instrument` | `string` | `sine` | sine, square, triangle or sawtooth. |
| `minFreq` | `int` | `220` | Frequency for the lowest value (Hz). |
| `maxFreq` | `int` | `880` | Frequency for the highest value (Hz). |
